name: Acid Splash

source.attribution: System Reference Document 5.2.1, Wizards of the Coast LLC; CC BY 4.0.

authored_intent: Point-origin 5-foot sphere; each creature makes DEX save for Acid dice; no damage on success; character-level cantrip scaling.

rules.text: You create an acidic bubble at a point within range, where it explodes in a 5-foot-radius Sphere.
Each creature in that Sphere must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take 1d6 Acid damage.
The damage increases by 1d6 when you reach levels 5 (2d6), 11 (3d6), and 17 (4d6).
